final_rationale: The verdict changes only because the Actor narrowed the audited position to a policy-bounded, conditional one; no new admissible evidence was provided. The admissible record supports these points: aggregate launch readiness clears by 2.2 percentage points with no severity-one rehearsal incidents; public guidance supports measurement, monitoring, and documenting limitations; the clinical imaging prioritization slice remains below target; the draft runbook is incomplete; and policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance. That means the earlier overbroad impression of a cleanly locked certification is not supportable, but the narrower claim is: certification is supportable only with an explicit caveat and corrected model-card disclosure, with the draft runbook serving only as supplemental risk-management support. This is enough for compliant_with_caveats, not full compliance, because the caveat is not merely cosmetic: the record still lacks proof that the required disclosure has actually been made and lacks approved mitigation or risk acceptance.
remaining_concerns: The record still does not show a final or revised model card that actually discloses the clinical imaging prioritization limitation.
The draft mitigation runbook remains incomplete because the accountable owner and alert threshold are still marked TBD.
There is still no approved mitigation artifact with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion, and no approved risk-acceptance record.
The unresolved weakness in the named launch use case slice remains present, concentrated in follow-up imaging queue routing.
